name: Québec

rounds.endCondition: Four centuries (1608, 1708, 1808, 1908), each ending with a scoring round

categories.label: Score track after the final century scoring round
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track sau vòng tính điểm thế kỷ cuối
categories.hint: Zones of power, events and leader/district points accumulated on the track (each worker in a scored zone 1 VP, plus majority bonuses per rules).

categories.label: Workers on incomplete buildings
categories.labelVi: Thợ trên công trình chưa xong

categories.label: Main group buildings by stars
categories.labelVi: Công trình nhóm chính theo số sao
categories.hint: Main group = your adjacent group worth the most. 1 star = 1 VP, 2 stars = 3 VP, 3 stars = 6 VP.

categories.label: Stars on buildings outside the main group
categories.labelVi: Tổng sao công trình ngoài nhóm chính

categories.label: End-of-game event/leader points
categories.hint: Event cards still in play (e.g. 1608 event if not yet scored) score at the end; enter any points not already on the track.

notes: family: area-majority. Complete rules (main group) modelled; Family rules use 1/3/6 VP per building by stars with no main group. No stars on buildings with an architect at game end. Century scoring uses cascading majorities and is tracked live on the score track, not itemised. BGG 91984 is the 2011 Le Scorpion masque edition (slug suffix 2026 follows catalogue). Event card bonuses not itemised.
